Cotypist syncs your recorded writing between your Macs through your own iCloud account, along with the on-screen context it was written in. Customize how Cotypist completes your text by providing instructions below. Focus on adding information highly relevant to your writing, such as your occupation and the types of writing tasks you frequently perform. Cotypist can record what you type in the fields where it suggests text, so its completions match your own words and phrases.

All recorded text is encrypted and stored locally on your Mac — nothing is sent to external servers unless you switch on the end-to-end encrypted iCloud sync between your Macs (in Cotypist Labs settings). In addition, you can switch off the recording for specific apps via the Cotypist menu bar icon. [Learn more about how Cotypist protects your privacy](https://cotypist.app/help/privacy?utm_source=app&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=personalizationSettings).

Nevertheless, we do not recommend enabling this option if you work with particularly sensitive information or feel uncomfortable with the idea of nearly all your writing being recorded — even if only locally on your Mac.
